His career extended beyond property into banking and communications. In his native Poland, he backed financial services and cable television as the country opened its economy after communist rule.

long_biography.plain_text:
David Theodore Chase rebuilt his life in Hartford after surviving the Holocaust and arriving in the United States in 1946. While completing school, he sold sheets, pillowcases and mattresses in surrounding towns. His knowledge of Slavic languages helped him speak with customers. Selling household goods and taking small building jobs preceded the larger enterprise he developed.

Chase directed substantial effort towards education and remembrance. He helped establish the United States Holocaust Memorial Museum and raised support for Yad Vashem. As chairman of the Machne Yisrael Development Fund, he mobilised other donors to build and expand Jewish community centres.

uncertainties.detail: Family obituary and documentary identify Kielce; Chabad biography identifies Sosnowiec. Documentary gives 1928, while an indexed 1994 Congressional tribute gives 6 May 1929 and one memorial headline reports age 86 instead of 88. The Congressional PDF did not open. Exact birth date and city are withheld; Poland is consistent. Parent cross-review found an opened 1987 biographical enclosure in the Reagan Library (S8) giving 6 May 1929 and Kielce. This is stronger contemporary support for that candidate date, but does not resolve the contradictory family documentary year or obituary age, so no exact birth-date proposal is made.

Historical diversification into retail, banking, manufacturing and communications is well established, but the complete retained asset mix at death is not. Primary industry is an explicit origin-sector fallback. No current descendants’ holdings, personal net worth, or later family gifts are assigned to the deceased founder.

Saved age 88 appears to reflect death, not age at the 2020 reference date. Wife Rhoda and children Arnold and Cheryl are explicitly named; no relationship to queued Daniel A. Chase is assumed. The vessel end month matches death, while broker attribution supplies family context rather than a direct David ownership declaration.

Public giving remains ordinary biography evidence; no unsupported generic philanthropy tag or incidental sector tags are added.
